title: MCP Transport & DNS-Rebinding Security Auditor
description: Audits an MCP server's transport security posture — Origin/Host validation, loopback binding, DNS-rebinding protection, and token passthrough — against the spec requirements and the rmcp / mcp-toolbox CVE classes. Reference rules are static and may age — verify against the live MCP spec.
